entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I need to start a return for an order I received last month.
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and the order number, please?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF55219. It's for the AeroPro helmet.

Thank you, Sam. I see the order here, delivered 45 days ago. Just to be sure I'm assisting you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference issue. The color wasn't quite what I expected from the website photos. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging; the box is unopened, so it's in perfect condition.

I understand completely. Let me just review the policy for you. One moment... Okay, thank you for your patience. Since the helmet was delivered 45 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for a full refund for you right now.

That's good to hear. Now, since I have to handle the return shipping and all, and I am planning to buy another helmet from you in a different color, could you maybe offer a 10% discount code for my next purchase to make up for the trouble?

I appreciate you asking, Sam. While I can't provide a discount code for a return based on color preference, I can assure you the return process is straightforward and the refund will be issued promptly once we receive the item. We want to make sure you get the right gear for both style and safety.
Alright, I thought it was worth a shot. No problem. Please go ahead and start the return process.
Of course. I've just initiated the return. You will receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sam. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
